and.structure: same rule applied to every bit position independently (2 inputs per bit)

or.structure: same rule applied to every bit position independently (2 inputs per bit)

xor.structure: same rule applied to every bit position independently (2 inputs per bit)

add.structure: walks bits lowest to highest bit carrying 1 state bit(s) (starting at [0]), then emits its final state

sub.structure: walks bits lowest to highest bit carrying 1 state bit(s) (starting at [0]), then emits its final state

lt.structure: walks bits lowest to highest bit carrying 1 state bit(s) (starting at [0]), then emits its final state

shr.structure: walks bits highest to lowest bit carrying 1 state bit(s) (starting at [0])

mul.structure: acc = 0; for each bit of x1 (highest to lowest): acc = (acc add (acc add (x0 and mask)))

popcount.structure: acc = 0; for each bit of x0 (highest to lowest): acc = (acc add bit)

reverse.structure: acc = 0; for each bit of x0 (lowest to highest): acc = (acc add (acc add bit))

avg.structure: walks bits highest to lowest bit carrying 1 state bit(s) (starting at [0])

div.structure: same rule applied to every bit position independently (2 inputs per bit)

max: the larger of two numbers
  shape: 2 operand(s) of W bits -> W bits
  vector program (composition search), disassembled from its tensors:
    r0 = input x0
    r1 = input x1
    r2 = ones
    r3 = zero
    r4 = zero
    r5 = zero
    @0: r3 = lt(r1, r0)
    @1: r4 = add(r2, r3)
    @2: r5 = mux(r0, r1, r4)
    result = r5
